attchmntText: Rajdarshan Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rajdarshan Industries Limited reported standalone and consolidated un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, approved by the Board on November 14, 2026. The company recorded a net loss of 17.13 lakhs for the quarter. Revenue from operations was 0.00 lakhs. Total expenses stood at 20.33 lakhs. Earnings per share was negative 0.55. The trading window for dealing in company securities remains closed until 48 hours after the financial results are made public.
